original_finding_resolution.evidence: Nonempty complete atomic donor guard is required. EACH pending await clears _events, sets _watch true for dispatch, resets it false afterwards and requires _events.is_empty(). Existing exact native lifecycle retirement classification is unchanged. The bridge must settle the actual operation and cleanup before returning; no passed callback-silence result is claimed.

Atomic guard includes nonempty actual installed camera diagnostics. Camera must be live, in the actual Player World3D, current in its actual Viewport and have a valid camera RID. Identity/world/space/viewport/rect, actual global and offset camera transforms, projection settings and full native projection-matrix columns are recorded. Transform3D/Basis/Vector3 and added Vector2/Vector4 branches recursively close unsupported native leaves into exact JSON data. Scalars retain actual types; nonfinite/unsupported values make Exact.stringify empty and atomic guard refuse. No camera writes or saved-authority/cache use occur.

original_finding_resolution.status: separate preparation-error source path added; cleanup gap below remains
original_finding_resolution.evidence: prepare_raw_with_fault is a fixture-only unbound bridge operation. Healthy raw signature and original support/floor are checked with zero normal/restore entries and commits. Read-only custody fields require nonempty named actual injection point, captured flag and captured floor guard, matching original floor identity/RID. Only then original support is disabled. The faulted candidate identity is tracked separately so other valid prepared rows do not cause a false failure. That identity must have a raw observation and must not have registered/entered/committed success observations. Actual preparation String error, zero constructor/commit/validator metrics, full donor camera/native/disk guard and quiet callbacks are required. Existing floor fault callback now explicitly requires successful sole construction before real synchronous validator mutation.
original_finding_resolution.mapping_obligation: Future Root implementation mapping must document its real post-immutable-custody/pre-entry injection point and return actual observations/errors; the smoke does not invoke or invent a shared/public runtime hook.

findings.title: Known raw candidate can take generic zero-candidate cleanup branch
findings.evidence: The new raw path proves an actual candidate was observed and faulted, but its final cleanup assertion delegates only to _bridge_refs_freed. That unchanged generic helper accepts an empty candidate_refs Array plus created_candidate_count == 0, a valid case only for malformed header refusal before native construction. It has no independent WeakRefs of the known faulted raw subtree.
findings.impact: The new raw-preparation test can accept a logically inconsistent zero-construction cleanup record and fail to detect a retained actual corrupted candidate/world. This is a gap in the newly added cleanup assertion, not a shared implementation defect.
findings.minimal_inert_repair: Require positive observed construction count and nonempty original bridge candidate refs specifically for the raw case, capture actual raw arena-root/subtree WeakRefs at the successful fault callback, and require those refs freed after dispatch. Preserve the generic zero branch for legitimate header-only malformed failures. Do not synthesize counts or disposal references.

next_scope: Only review the positive raw construction count/nonempty bridge refs and independently captured actual raw subtree WeakRef cleanup in the final derivative; no broader re-audit.
